title: Complaint Mentions and Phone Key Setup
summary: This topic groups brief mentions of complaints, including positive statements saying there were no complaints and undetermined references to complaints such as phone key setup.

positive.summary: Positive reviews say there were no complaints about the salespeople or the driving experience.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention complaints in general or cite phone key setup and community complaint discussions without enough detail to classify sentiment more specifically.

limitations: Most fragments are too brief or incomplete to identify the specific underlying issue beyond generic complaint mentions.
The cluster mixes general statements about having or not having complaints with one more specific reference to phone key setup, so the topic is not fully coherent.
Samples are sentiment-stratified and not representative estimates of the full review population.
